Gold fell 1.85% to $4,366.10 Tuesday morning, and the whole precious metals board went with it.

Silver dropped 3.13% to $64.44, platinum 2.12% to $1,753.00 and palladium 3.84% to $1,304.00, erasing thirteen days of August's rally in one session. Measured against 19 August instead of the high, gold, silver and platinum are still within 2.1% of where they started.

Silver fell 3.13% to $64.44 Tuesday morning, leading four metals lower at the reopen.

Gold slid 1.85% to $4,366.10, platinum 2.12% to $1,753.00 and palladium 3.84% to $1,304.00. The gold-silver ratio widened to 67.75 from 66.46 Monday, a sign the trade sold the whole complex rather than one metal.
